page.overview:
Who is Fang Ren?

Fang Ren is a fictional intelligence operative based in Hong Kong. The character appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage.

Daughter of a powerful family who spanned both political and criminal spheres, Fang Ren is as accustomed to high culture dinner parties as she is navigating the seedy underworld. Her preferred modus operandi is to seduce her target into submission and then remove their beating heart just after they pledge their undying love. Despite this perverse pleasure, she is thought to keep them in formaldehyde jars for sentimental value.

Having a murderous ex-husband, she is skilled in deception, hand-to-hand combat and interrogation, and is multi-lingual, speaking Chinese, English, Japanese and Vietnamese. The character offers an increased critical damage buff and provides a +15 total offence bonus using lie detectors and +10 total offence using tasers. She is a 'common agent' (white) and can be levelled to level 5.
